rules.description: You may not be eligible to receive a welcome offer if you have or have had this Card or previous versions of this Card.

You also may not be eligible to receive a welcome offer based on various factors, such as your history with credit card balance transfers, your history as an American Express Card Member, the number of credit cards that you have opened and closed and other factors.

welcome_offer.description: Variable welcome offer: up to 300,000 Membership Rewards® points ("apply and find out your welcome offer, as high as 300,000") after you spend $20,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 3 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer; American Express shows the exact amount after you apply. No fixed public offer amount is published.
notes: 2026-11-13 as-high-as policy (lead decision after #95): official Amex product page (rendered GET 200, 9:20:24 PM PST): "APPLY AND FIND OUT YOUR WELCOME OFFER AS HIGH AS 300,000 Membership Rewards® Points after you spend $20,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 3 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer." Offer terms page (GET 200, 9:21:17 PM PST): "As High As 300,000 Membership Rewards® points Welcome Offer ... which will be an amount as high as 300,000 points. No 'Offer ends' date or limited-time/increased-offer language on the page.
